market_question: Will Arsenal finish in 2nd place in the 2025-26 English Premier League?
reasoning: Arsenal have finished 2nd in the last two completed Premier League seasons (2022-23, 2023-24) and remain a top team under Mikel Arteta with a strong squad. Historical data suggests a ~25-30% chance of finishing exactly second, whereas the market implies only 16.5%. While predicting an exact league position over a year in advance is never certain, the current price appears to undervalue a realistic outcome.
evidence_points: Arsenal finished 2nd in both 2022-23 and 2023-24 EPL seasons.
Squad depth and managerial stability under Arteta make them strong candidates for top-two finishes.
Competitors like Manchester City and Liverpool can fluctuate, leaving the 2nd-place outcome at a material probability.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Arsenal's squad and form as of early 2025
